_note: ZH (Simplified Chinese, zh-Hans) — third launch locale. Keys mirror ru.json exactly. A missing key falls back to ru (the contract) via i18n.config fallbackLocale, so a partial translation still renders. Chinese has ONE grammatical number form, so plural keys have a single slot (no pipes); the built-in plural rule handles it.
